title: Jets fail to capitalize on breakout performances from Braelon Allen, Adonai Mitchell in Raiders loss

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fail to capitalize on breakout performances from Braelon Allen, Adonai Mitchell in Raiders loss
sources.description: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen and wide receiver Adonai Mitchell posted career-best performances in Sunday's loss to the Las Vegas Raiders, but a series of costly mistakes on both ends of the field kept New York trapped in the loss column.
